digest.component_or_area: Gerrit CI/CD workflow and verification routing
propositions: Documentation-only Gerrit changes currently consume the full OS/Python build matrix, mutation, packaging, and other jobs despite requiring only documentation validation gates.
A trusted classifier job must route patchsets based on allowlisted documentation-only paths, with all non-documentation paths or uncertainty selecting full Verify to preserve security.
Documentation gates must be extracted into a single shared composite action and invoked by both docs-only and full verify lanes without adding a new runner job or duplicating gate definitions.

Classifier logic and the allowlist must execute only from trusted origin/main with the exact patchset name-only diff as untrusted input, using fail-closed parent resolution and deepened HEAD^..HEAD checkout.
Existing workflow structure and gate-parity tests must be migrated to follow the extracted documentation action without losing assertions or weakening invariants.
Verified vote must require classifier success and either docs-only-gate success or all full-route-job success, blocking Verified on classifier failure even if full jobs pass.
